legend: Jar Jar Binks wants to profit from his Jar Jar Drinks, so he opens a bar serving his galaxy-famous Jawa Juice. However, he isn't making much profit from selling drinks alone; so he had the great idea of adding food onto his menu. Jar Jar thinks, and he comes up with a great idea – pizza!

He gets his four-fingered hands on n$$$n$$$ rectangular pizzas, where the i$$$i$$$-th pizza is wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ inches. But Jar Jar Binks doesn't stop here. Jar Jar Binks loves four-sided regular polygons because four is the largest number he can count up to on his fingers. So the natural conclusion (for him) is to create the biggest square pizza possible!

Jar Jar Binks can do a few things to construct his big square pizza. Beforehand, he can rotate any of his wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ pizzas to become hi×wi$$$h_i \times w_i$$$ pizzas. He can also cut off unnecessary pieces from any pizza to be reshaped to w′i×h′i$$$w_i' \times h_i'$$$ where 0<w′i≤wi$$$0  \lt  w_i' \le w_i$$$ and 0<h′i≤hi$$$0  \lt  h_i' \le h_i$$$. Afterward, he can horizontally concatenate some or all of the pizzas to form the larger pizza. Note that any scraps cut off from a pizza are thrown away (into his belly) and the large concatenated pizza cannot be rotated.

But because Jar Jar stinks, he can't do the math to figure out how large he can make his square pizza! So he asks you this – What are the dimensions of the biggest square$$$\textbf{square}$$$ pizza Jar Jar Binks can create?
input: The first line contains one positive integer n(1≤n≤105)$$$n \: (1 \le n \le 10^5)$$$ – the number of pizzas Jar Jar Binks has.

Then n$$$n$$$ lines follow. The i$$$i$$$-th line contains 2 integers ai$$$a_i$$$, bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai,bi≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i, b_i \le 10^9)$$$, where ai$$$a_i$$$ denotes the width and bi$$$b_i$$$ denotes the length of the i$$$i$$$-th pizza.
output: Print one integer – the dimension of 1$$$1$$$ side of the biggest square$$$\textbf{square}$$$ pizza.
note: In the first test case, notice that one way for Jar Jar Binks to create a 5×5$$$5 \times 5$$$ square pizza is to rotate the 6×3$$$6 \times 3$$$ pizza and concatenate it with the 2×5$$$2 \times 5$$$ pizza. Notice that Jar Jar Binks cannot create a larger square pizza as that would require vertical concatenation of pizzas, or is simply impossible.
In the second test case, notice that the largest square pizza Jar Jar Binks can create is a 1×1$$$1 \times 1$$$ square pizza.

legend.ai: Jar Jar Binks 想从自己的 Jar Jar Drinks 中获利，于是他开了一家酒吧，供应在整个星系都闻名的 Jawa Juice。然而，仅靠售卖饮料并不能赚到多少利润；于是他想出了一个绝妙的主意，将食物加入菜单。Jar Jar 思考了一番，想出了一个绝妙的主意——披萨！
他弄到了 n$$$n$$$ 个矩形披萨，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个披萨的尺寸为 wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ 英寸。但 Jar Jar Binks 并未就此止步。Jar Jar Binks 喜欢四边正多边形，因为四是他用手指能数到的最大数字。因此，对他而言，自然的结论就是制作尽可能大的正方形披萨！

Jar Jar Binks 可以进行一些操作来制作他的大正方形披萨。首先，他可以将任意一个 wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ 的披萨旋转成 hi×wi$$$h_i \times w_i$$$ 的披萨。他还可以从任意披萨上切掉多余的部分，将其重新裁成 w′i×h′i$$$w_i' \times h_i'$$$，其中 0<w′i≤wi$$$0  \lt  w_i' \le w_i$$$ 且 0<h′i≤hi$$$0  \lt  h_i' \le h_i$$$。之后，他可以将部分或全部披萨沿水平方向拼接起来，形成更大的披萨。注意，从披萨上切下的所有碎片都会被丢弃(丢进他的肚子里)，并且拼接得到的大披萨不能旋转。
但是，由于 Jar Jar 很臭，他无法计算出自己能制作出多大的正方形披萨！所以他想问你：Jar Jar Binks 能制作出的最大正方形$$$\textbf{square}$$$披萨的尺寸是多少？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个正整数 n(1≤n≤105)$$$n \: (1 \le n \le 10^5)$$$，表示 Jar Jar Binks 拥有的披萨数量。
接下来有 n$$$n$$$ 行。第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含 2 个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$、bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai,bi≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i, b_i \le 10^9)$$$，其中 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个披萨的宽度，bi$$$b_i$$$ 表示其长度。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示最大正方形$$$\textbf{square}$$$披萨一条边的边长 1$$$1$$$。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，注意 Jar Jar Binks 可以将 6×3$$$6 \times 3$$$ 的披萨旋转后与 2×5$$$2 \times 5$$$ 的披萨拼接，从而得到一个 5×5$$$5 \times 5$$$ 的正方形披萨。注意，Jar Jar Binks 无法制作出更大的正方形披萨，因为这需要将披萨纵向拼接，或者这种拼接根本不可能。
在第二个测试用例中，注意 Jar Jar Binks 能制作出的最大正方形披萨是一个 1×1$$$1 \times 1$$$ 的正方形披萨。
